msg: Pregunta, supongo que no están saliendo con el clima verdad?
reply:
Las salidas se suspenden solo si las condiciones meteorológicas afectan la seguridad. Si la Capitanía de Puerto cierra las salidas, primero se intenta reprogramar; si no es posible, se reembolsa el 100%.

Operamos todos los días del año salvo el 25 de diciembre y el 1 de enero, y la seguridad va primero: si el mar no está apto, la salida se reprograma. La previsión de un día concreto te la confirma el equipo: te paso ahora con alguien que te escribe por aquí enseguida.

msg: Hi. We want to complete our PADI open water: we have referrals and e-learning certificates. We would also like a refresher first. How does the 2 day open water referral course cost plus a mini course the day before. 2 persons. Thanks
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

Great—you can complete your Open Water certification with the 2-day Referral Course, since you’ve already done the theory and pool sessions. The refresher is booked as a Dive Mini Course and is a separate activity; it doesn’t count toward the certification.

You’ll need to stay overnight on the islands after day 1; accommodation isn’t included.

The online prices include the 10% website discount. The exact total for both people will be shown in the booking checkout. The Referral Course details are here: https://divingplanet.org/curso-padi-cartagena/referido/; I don’t have its booking link available here.

The Mini Course is a guided experience and does not certify; to get certified, you need the Open Water course (2 days, including an overnight stay on the islands).

Please note: the refresher is normally required if it’s been more than 2 years since your last dive. You’ll also need to bring referral paperwork signed by a PADI instructor.

To give you the exact price I need to know where you're starting from: would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Plans and prices change depending on the departure point. 🌊
